steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: S-stop!

Thanks to the Campbells' rigorous training regimens, Hypatia's physical strength and endurance are, by noble standards, quite respectable. But chasing a fugitive across the chaotic rooftops of the civilian district is another matter entirely. Despite her efforts, the gap between her and her prey remains stubbornly open.

The bandaged man, in contrast, moves with infuriating ease. He navigates shantytown alleyways and scrambled paths, using the terrain to obstruct her while casually tracking her position. Just like right now, startling an innocent resident in their path easily forces the refined lady into a breathless apology while running.
But he never drops his guard. This noble researcher has already proven herself dangerously intelligent and unnervingly persistent.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I said... stop!

From the man's blind spot, another Aurum Secretum probe zips into view. He abandons the idea of destroying it this time. Instead, he grabs a plastic basin from a nearby home, traps the device beneath it, and claps an iron pot on top to secure his makeshift prison.

steps.speaker: Bandaged Man
steps.content: Hah... So many little toys. Did I wander into some spy film fan's daydream?

steps.speaker: Bandaged Man
steps.content: Persistent, she is.

Probably within a minute, that little hunter will transform again, twisting into a worm-like shape to bore its way free. Meanwhile, the girl has finally hauled herself over the low wall and resumed her pursuit, her portable Aurum Secretum device humming in her wake, its light cutting golden arcs through the dark.
Staying ahead of her is one thing. Shaking her for good is another...

The man's gaze flicks to the next intersection, where the light and noise of the bustling night beckon. The bandages covering the lower half of his face pull tight, creasing into an eerie, knowing shadow.

steps.speaker: Bandaged Man
steps.content: ...Heh. Time to borrow the crowd.

With a nimble leap, he gains a higher rooftop. In two long strides, he dives into the flickering neon sea of the marketplace. The crowd swallows him with barely a ripple; the night is that dense, that packed.
It's some financial company's promotion night. A giant mascot stands at the crowd's center, barking amplified advertisements through a loudspeaker.

steps.speaker: Finance Mascot
steps.content: Earn in Fraser, spend in Fraser! Short on funds? We've got your back! Low-risk, high-reward; it's practically a license to print money!

steps.speaker: Bandaged Man
steps.content: Thank you for the assist.

steps.speaker: Finance Mascot
steps.content: Eek?!! Who was that? Who touched me?! What is it?!

steps.speaker: Pedestrian A
steps.content: Ah?!

steps.speaker: Pedestrian B
steps.content: Eh!

steps.speaker: Pedestrian C
steps.content: Huh??

Startled cries ripple through the crowd. People turn, bewildered, after being mysteriously tapped on the shoulder, unable to spot the culprit. Unknowingly, they have become links in a living chain. It's as if the night itself has taken the form of a fish, darting through the human current. Wherever it passes, an irresistible urge compels a hand to reach out and tap the next stranger.

What they cannot see is far more sinister. Where each was touched, a black-red pattern, like creeping vines, begins to bloom beneath their clothes. Mania seeps from these marks, threads of invisible corruption stretching between victims to form a vast, unseen web. Then, as the crowd shifts...

steps.speaker: Pedestrian D
steps.content: Eeeek!! Ouch—

For no apparent reason, people suddenly pitch forward, toppling in a swift, grotesque domino effect. As if orchestrated, Hypatia arrives at this exact stretch of crowd just as the tangle of fallen bodies forms an impassable barricade.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Ugh! To think he actually dares to employ sorcery in the downtown...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: That vile Undergrounder! I swear I will—

Just as she tries to push forward in pursuit, her coat is abruptly tugged back. An elderly man has fallen to the ground, clutching his lower back in pain, his hand tangled in her hem as he struggles to call for help.

steps.speaker: Fraser Elder
steps.content: Ah, my back... it hurts really bad... Could someone... help an old man up? Oh my fragile heart...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But I...
Ahead, the villain is vanishing into the chaos. Here, an old man lies helpless on the ground, seconds from being trampled.
Hypatia is torn, but in the space of a heartbeat, the choice is made. She yields, as she always must, to the ancient instinct carved into her soul and written in her blood.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I will not abandon you. Here, take my arm. It is not safe here; I will help you to the side of the road... Ah, careful!

steps.speaker: Fraser Elder
steps.content: Thank you, dear child, bless your kind heart... Just over there, a little further up...

With the old man leaning heavily on her arm, their progress toward the roadside is a slow, halting shuffle. Hypatia struggles to maintain focus, her control over the distant Aurum Secretum probe flickering.

With every forced pause, the thought curdles: her enemy could be a mile away now, his lead stretching with each second she spends here. The anxiety thickens inside her, dense and cloying as Fraser's heavy cream.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I'm sorry... Ms. Margaret. I cannot simply abandon them... I will see this elder to safety, then I will catch up to that Undergrounder. I will not fail you.

steps.speaker: Eerie Echo
steps.content: You possess even more conviction than I imagined, Miss Hypatia Campbell.
Her gaze immediately sweeps the vicinity with heightened vigilance, finding no one. Simultaneously, her Aurum Secretum probe confirms its distant target remains ahead. Then...

A moment of focused analysis reveals the truth: the sound resonates directly within her mind, carrying the distinct psychic signature of Mania. It's a form of Mania sorcery, and its anchor point is the elderly man leaning on her arm.
A perfect two-part gambit: delay the pursuer, then open a direct line of communication.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Show yourself, you coward. Cease using innocent civilians as your Mania conduit and face me directly.

steps.speaker: Eerie Echo
steps.content: Peace, please. It's a modified type with minimal Mania exposure. Harmless; it'll clear after a night's rest, impossible to stand in your way. I only resorted to this desperate measure because your tracking prowess left me few alternatives.

steps.speaker: Eerie Echo
steps.content: The war is over. Must this animosity persist? So... let me offer an apology.

steps.speaker: Eerie Echo
steps.content:
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color> ...
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color> It's all mere conjecture for now. I need to gather more data before we can verify our assumption. It will take time. The MBCC will support me as we further investigate the Sillage Society. We'll get to the bottom of this.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color> However... one thing is certain.

steps.speaker: Eerie Echo
steps.content: Might I kindly request you to call off the hunt? At least here, in Fraser. For both our sakes, a public spectacle benefits no one.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: What? You believe that is why I pursue you?

steps.speaker: Eerie Echo
steps.content: Is it not? On whose authority, then, do you hunt me so relentlessly?

steps.speaker: Eerie Echo
steps.content: The Luminaris Society, who taught you your craft? The Campbell family, guardians of Fraser's interests? Or perhaps...

steps.speaker: Eerie Echo
steps.content: ...are you another little operative on a special mission?
The words are spoken lightly, yet they stir up a tempest in Hypatia's heart.
[Flashback CG: Underground Incident and Hypatia's Hate]

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: None of those!

steps.speaker: Fraser Elder
steps.content: Oh, my heart!

The elder's cry in pain is the only chain holding back Hypatia's fury. Every muscle strains—partly to support his weight, partly to keep herself rooted to the spot and not hurtle after the fleeing enemy.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Cease your feigned ignorance, Undergrounder... Your sorcery, the Mania you spread, the Black Ring... I have seen your crimes with my own eyes. The scars you left upon this land are etched in my memory.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: So many were led to ruin by your kind. Was secretly orchestrating BR-005 not enough? Now you slither into Fraser... What discord do you seek to sow here? Was your assault on Margaret meant to shatter our peace, to rekindle the war?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I act on no one's orders. I take no one's "side." I act for all those you have broken. To expose you. To end you. I will no longer stand by while you wreak your havoc!

steps.speaker: Eerie Echo
steps.content: Pfft... hah! A champion for the suffering masses, is it? I see now. Such a righteous, pure-hearted soul. Precisely why you should step back now, before the mire claims you too...

steps.speaker: Eerie Echo
steps.content: Tell you what. I'll withdraw the sorcery now. I'll even swear a solemn oath to sever ties with all those... unsavory associates. No more trouble from me. And you...

steps.speaker: Eerie Echo
steps.content: Don't fixate on catching me. Don't rush to settle scores with the Underground. If you truly wish to aid the people of the farlands... there is a better path available to you now.

steps.speaker: Eerie Echo
steps.content: See this man to safety, then go home. To truly help, start with what is before you. And keep yourself safe. Fraser is unsettled. Good souls like you should be wary.

steps.speaker: Eerie Echo
steps.content: Don't wander too deep. Don't stay out too late. It's perilous. Learn to look after yourself first. As I have. Understood?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...What are you saying? I—

steps.speaker: Eerie Echo
steps.content: The more we talk, the firmer your resolve becomes. So... threat neutralized, long live peace. Farewell?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Wait!

The psychic resonance in her mind shatters. Her hearing snaps back to the ordinary clamor of the city as, around her, the Mania-puppeteered people begin to stir. They rise slowly, muttering in confusion, and are absorbed back into the bustling crowd.
The meaning is unmistakable. He has severed the link. He is gone.

steps.speaker: Fraser Elder
steps.content: Y-young lady? Are you quite alright? You seem pale.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I am well. Please forgive my distraction. This way, mind your step.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Are these your family? I am relieved. Think nothing of it; it was my duty. I must attend to other matters now; please excuse my lack of a proper introduction. I wish you and your family safety and happiness.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Goodbye!
She dashes away like the wind, making her way to higher ground.
The crowd below churns with normalcy, oblivious.

Her Aurum Secretum probe, target lost, settles onto her wrist. Frantic, she sweeps her gaze across the scene. She spots a commotion and launches the probe toward it, then pivots herself to intercept a second suspicious movement.

Her undisguised panic draws stares. After her third bow of apology to a startled civilian she's mistaken for her target, the frantic energy leaves her. She slows to a stop in the river of people, chest heaving.

On the bustling street, no alarm sounds, no answer comes. Every face seems to hold the ghost of a memory—they saw something—yet they move through the night as if it were utterly ordinary, just another unremarkable evening in a string of thousands.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Oh my... where did he go...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: An accomplice? Am I walking into a trap? Or... is he in trouble himself? His extreme reaction to the Aurum Secretum device detecting the Black Ring residue... that's what gave him away. It was... visceral. Defensive.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But no malice in the crowd sorcery. During his escape, he impeded, but never attacked. He swore he'd cut ties. So why the midnight attack? Who is he acting for now?
Mid-thought, a dangerous glint of silver flickers at the edge of her vision. She stops dead, the attack whistling past where she'd just been.
The attacker stands revealed on a distant hotel rooftop: a figure in a pitch-black cloak, face swathed in bandages, with only a pair of fierce, blood-red eyes visible.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Who are you?!
The assassin, clad in black, spreads his hands. From his fingertips, the silent, corrupted flames of Underground sorcery ignite, and begin to devour the bandages that mask his face.

steps.speaker: Fraser Assassin
steps.content: ...Are you... looking for me?

steps.speaker: Fraser Assassin
steps.content: The runaway... Campbell... Hypatia Campbell. Perfect...

steps.speaker: Fraser Assassin
steps.content: I will bring you back, alive or otherwise.
